candidates.title: OpScale: Operator-level Provisioning and Autoscaling for LLM Serving
candidates.reason: model全体ではなくoperatorをscaling unitとし、profiling・provisioning・placement・runtime servingをoperator granularityで統合。production traceを用いた最大40 A100/24 GB200評価でSLOを満たしつつGPU 36.3%削減・power 28%削減、固定costでthroughput 44%改善を示す実装研究。

candidates.title: ORBITFLOW: SLO-Aware Long-Context LLM Serving with Fine-Grained KV Cache Reconfiguration
candidates.reason: long-context servingでrequest/layer単位にGPU保持KVをILPで選び、runtime feedbackでplacementを再構成するadaptive offload system。TPOT/TBT SLO attainmentを最大66%/48%改善、p95 latency 38%削減、throughput最大3.3倍を報告し、静的offloadとの差分が明確。

candidates.title: SLOs-Serve: Optimized Serving of Multi-SLO LLMs
candidates.reason: application/stage別SLOに対しchunked prefillとoptional speculative decodingのtoken allocationをdynamic programmingで連続最適化し、multi-replica routingまで統合。6 application scenarioでper-GPU serving capacity平均2.2倍を示す。

discovery_stats.axis: operator-level autoscaling・SLO-aware KV reconfiguration・multi-SLO token allocation
discovery_stats.query_summary: mobile runtimeからcloud capacity/SLO制御へ切替。autoscaling、long-context KV reconfiguration、multi-SLO schedulingを探索し、default branch canonical ID検索で未収録の3件を送信した。
